Find their set intersection and check your selected plan against each list. Exactly one plan is common to all three lists. All evidence is available here; no other agent is needed.
e26f5 (attendee availability): plan_1, plan_4, plan_6, plan_7
e7fff (equipment availability): plan_1, plan_5, plan_6, plan_8
